## Limits and transparency

- We do not guarantee results that do not depend only on our own work.
- Work outside the agreed scope is quoted at {{extra_hourly_rate}}/h and approved before we start.
- Monthly services can be cancelled with 7 days of notice before the next invoice.
- Support hours are Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 19:00. Outside those hours we reply the next business day.
- Delivery times start once we have everything we need from you.
- {{featured_action_limit_note}}

## Contact

- **Email:** {{contact_email}}
- **WhatsApp:** The WhatsApp button on the website opens a pre-written message. The number is not published as text; email is the main channel.
- **Form:** None. Contact is by email or WhatsApp.
- **Urgent requests:** Use the subject "URGENT" by email, or start the WhatsApp message with "URGENT".
- **{{featured_action_name}}:** Use the subject "{{featured_action_name}}".
